$comment: AutoMind AI bilingual DTC knowledge base, shared by the Python diagnosis engine and the Dart mobile app. Generic (SAE-defined) codes only; manufacturer-specific ranges are intentionally excluded. severity: info|low|medium|high|critical (critical = stop driving). related_signals reference outputs[].key in shared/obd/pids.json. Validate with: python3 tools/validate_kb.py shared/kb/dtc_definitions.json shared/obd/pids.json
source: Generic code descriptions per SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 (publicly documented generic DTC meanings). Common causes are general automotive knowledge, not vehicle-specific data.
